A [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''cryptologist''' assisted in the training of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] some [[Time/Legends|time]] before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="RC:HC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]'' in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Since the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] cryptologist is mentioned as a memory of [[Darman Skirata|RC-1136's]] training on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], she must have appeared before the year 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> The [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Darman Skirata|RC-1136]] remembered the Sullustan teaching a memorably unpleasant lesson on encryption techniques while he was training<ref name="RC:HC" /> on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] before the outbreak of the war.<ref name="RC:HC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sullustan cryptologist was mentioned in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact|Hard Contact]]'', the first novel in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' series written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="RC:HC" />
